The perception system includes a LiDAR sensor, a camera sensor, and a radar sensor."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P2", "text": "Outside the vehicle, there are a control center server that monitors the vehicle status and a charging station that charges the battery."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P3", "text": "When the driver requests autonomous driving activation, the vehicle control module activates the autonomous driving mode and the HMI displays the autonomous driving mode transition. Accordingly, the vehicle transitions from the manual driving state to the normal autonomous driving state."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P6", "text": "The vehicle control module generates steering/acceleration-deceleration control commands from the driving path, and the drive actuator executes the control commands."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P7", "text": "The V2X communication module transmits the vehicle status report to the control center server, and the control center server monitors the vehicle status."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P8", "text": "The camera sensor of the perception system detects a pedestrian ahead, and a pedestrian detection event occurs."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P9", "text": "To avoid a collision, the vehicle control module performs emergency braking within 200 ms."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P10", "text": "The perception system detects a LiDAR reliability degradation, and a LiDAR fault event occurs."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P11", "text": "For safety, the vehicle control module switches to the degraded mode, the vehicle transitions from the normal autonomous driving state to the degraded autonomous driving state, and the speed is limited to 30 km/h or less."},
